parole.testo: From Sindarin, a fictional language created by J.R.R. Tolkien, meaning something akin to "mighty demon".

parole.significato: A fictional silvery metal of great strength and value, primarily in fantasy and role-playing settings.
parole.testo: Coined by J. R. R. Tolkien in his constructed language Sindarin as mithril, from mith (“pale grey”) + a derivative of the Primitive Elvish root *ril- (‘brilliant light, glitter’).
